source: NSE daily bhavcopy, every session, delisted companies included
universe: NSE stocks trading Rs 10 crore a day or more, priced Rs 20 or more
rules: Bought at the next session's open, held for the period, left on a close under the exit line. Price returns before costs and tax. Index: Nifty 500.

young.what: Companies listed six to twelve months, their 6-month return standing in for the 12-month one, placed against the established universe.
Companies listed six to twelve months, their 6-month return standing in for the 12-month one, placed against the established universe.

results.what: Liquid companies whose quarterly results were first priced in the last 10 sessions, ordered by that session's move less the average liquid stock's. A list is made only when eight or more qualify.
results.bias: The results table holds companies listed today. vs_reporters compares the list with every company it was chosen from, which shares that bias.

short.what: A close above a 40-session range 18% wide or tighter on twice the usual volume in the last five sessions, still above it; above the 200-day average; leader score in the top half; six or more of nine chart conditions; its industry in the top half on money flow; no fall in profit last quarter; results, if just out, not sold by the market.
short.replay: The site's own engine run on every fifth session; its top fifteen bought at the next open.
short.bias: Industries are NSE's list as it stands today, and quarterly results start in 2018 and cover companies listed today. Before 2018 the profit screen passes everyone.

breakout.what: A close above the top of a 40- or 60-session base 28% wide or less that was 20% or tighter or tightened before the break, on 1.6 times the usual volume, in the top 45% of the day's range, within the last five sessions and still above it; above the 200-day average with the 50-day at least 98% of it; leader score 45 or more; its industry in the top 60% on money flow (a VCP launchpad). Or the first close above a 60-session top in 20 sessions, from a base 35% wide or less that tightened, on twice the usual volume, closing in the top 40% of the day, above rising 50- and 200-day averages, sales or profit growing where a quarter is on file, whatever the leader score (a base turnaround). For both: a month better than the Nifty 500's; not more than 16% above its 50-day average or 55% up in three months; no known fall in profit over 10% or results sold by the market. Held 63 sessions, left on a close 12% under.
breakout.replay: The site's own engine run on every fifth session; its top fifteen bought at the next open.
breakout.bias: Industries are NSE's list as it stands today, so a company since delisted has no industry here and passes that screen unread. Quarterly results start in 2018 and cover companies listed today; without one a stock is never refused for it.

technical.what: A rising 200-day average with price and the 50-day above it, leader score 55 or more; a low within 1.5% of the 20-day average in the last three sessions and a green close above it, no more than 6% over it; RSI 48 to 68; its industry in the top half on money flow; no known fall in profit over 10%. Held 63 sessions, left on a close 12% under.
technical.replay: The site's own engine run on every fifth session; its top fifteen bought at the next open.
technical.bias: Industries are NSE's list as it stands today, so a company since delisted has no industry here and passes that screen unread. Quarterly results start in 2018 and cover companies listed today; without one a stock is never refused for it.

quick.what: In an uptrend, leader score in the top 35%, a two-day RSI under 10 or a 4% fall in five sessions, still within 3% of its 50-day average, results not just sold. Held 21 sessions, left on a close 10% under.
quick.replay: The site's own engine run on every fifth session; its top fifteen bought at the next open.

flow.what: The three sectors ranked highest on rotation (45% their median stock's three months, 35% the share of their stocks above the 50-day average, 20% their share of turnover this week against sixty sessions); in each, the five strongest stocks in an uptrend, outside the most volatile fifth, within 15% of their high, and ahead of the Nifty 500 over one month and three. Held 63 sessions, left on a close 15% under.
flow.replay: The site's own engine run on every fifth session; its top fifteen bought at the next open.
flow.bias: Sectors are NSE's list as it stands today, so a company since delisted has no sector here and could not be picked.

emerging.what: Companies listed six to eighteen months, above a rising 50-day average, within 10% of their high, leader score 60 or more, ahead of the Nifty 500 over one month and three, no more than 18% over the 50-day, no loss or fall in sales last quarter where one is on file. Held 90 sessions; after 15, left on a close under the 50-day average; at any time on a close 15% under.
emerging.replay: The site's own engine run on every fifth session; its top fifteen bought at the next open.
emerging.bias: Industries are NSE's list as it stands today, so a company since delisted has no industry here and passes that screen unread. Quarterly results start in 2018 and cover companies listed today; without one a stock is never refused for it.

before.what: The 150 highest technical scores on the exchange, momentum and accumulation setups, Rs 2 crore a day, ordered by the old trade score. Its targets cannot be replayed from prices, so it is shown WITHOUT them, which flatters it.

first_version.what: The lists as first built: this month was three parts leader score and one part five-day dip, and momentum did not give way to long term. Same dates, same rules.
